data.body:
ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Audit CLAUDE.md rules referencing review/test gate by number

Add consideration: '[Maintainability] Multiple CLAUDE.md rules reference safeguards by number (e.g., rules 8, 11, 12, 18, 22 reference review-gate / record-review.sh / reviewer-findings.json). Renumbering after deletion is fragile — instead, rewrite each rule for the PR-enforcement model and re-verify cross-references in plugins/dso/docs/SUB-AGENT-BOUNDARIES.md, REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md, and skill-level prompt files (per-worktree-review-commit.md, fix-bug SKILL.md, sprint SKILL.md).'
